svg.title: Checklist for confirming page order before merging multiple PDFs
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Checklist for confirming page order before merging
multiple PDFs
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-24
Add sequence numbers to file names
Adobe Acrobat Help instructs users on Windows to
select Menu > Combine files, add files, and
change their order by dragging them in the merge…
Record each file’s page count first
Before merging, write down each file’s page
count in a text editor.
Preview the order and unnecessary
pages in the merge window
Adobe Help explains that before merging, you can
expand files to view individual pages, drag
thumbnails to change their order, and delete…
Compare the page count and boundary
pages after merging
Open the merged file and check whether its total
page count matches the total recorded in step 2.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
